About Me

More Than
Just Numbers

I'm a Computer Science (Data Science) graduate who genuinely loves the process of finding stories hidden inside data. Whether it's a messy CSV or a sprawling database, I enjoy untangling complexity and translating it into something meaningful.

Before I discovered data analytics I was always the person who wanted to know the "why" behind every outcome — now I get to do that professionally with Python, SQL, Power BI and a strong curiosity that never quite switches off.

Fuelled by Tea & CuriosityBest ideas come during late-night debugging sessions with a hot cup in hand.
Dashboard PerfectionistI obsess over clean visuals — every axis label and colour choice is intentional.
Continuous LearnerCurrently deepening knowledge in advanced SQL and storytelling with data.
Team-First MindsetThrives in collaborative settings where data supports real team decisions.
